committee: * PRESENTATION for Certificate 428-38 (LS)-Senator Vincent A.V. Borja
title: Håfa Adai! Please be advised that on Wednesday, August 19, 2026 , at 12:00 P.M. , Senator Vincent A.V. Borja will present Certificate 428-38 (LS) at Meskla Restaurant in recognition of Rosa G.
